exercises.instructionEn: Sandra and David are going to the Arctic Circle to write an article about Greenland's glaciers. Read the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Sandra va David Grenlandiya muzliklari haqida maqola yozish uchun Shimoliy qutb doirasiga bormoqda. Hikoyani o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-EPIZOD TARJIMASI:

1) David: Biz dunyoning cho'qqisiga
   ketyapmiz! Deyarli Shimoliy
   qutbdamiz!
   Sandra: Ha! Hayajonli emasmi?
   Mike bizga topshiriq haqida
   aytganida ishonmadim. U
   Grenlandiya muz qatlami tez
   erimoqda va olimlar bu ekologik
   falokatga sabab bo'lishi mumkin
   deb tashvishda, dedi.

2) Tony: Grenlandiyaga xush
   kelibsiz. Men Tony Francis,
   tadqiqot stansiyasidanman. U bu
   yerdan 600 km dan ko'proq
   shimolda, Shimoliy qutb doirasi
   ustida.
   Sandra: U yerga qanday boramiz?
   Juda uzoqligini bilaman, lekin it
   chanasida sayohat qilishni juda
   xohlardim!

3) Tony: Umidingni puchga
   chiqarganim uchun kechir, Sandra
   - samolyotda boramiz. Ana u!
   Ketganimiz ma'qul, chunki kech
   bo'lyapti.
   Sandra: Qorong'i tushishidan oldin
   tadqiqot stansiyasiga yetib
   boramizmi?

4) Tony: Tashvishlanma, David -
   Shimoliy qutb doirasi ustida yozda
   quyosh botmaydi. Biz yarim tungi
   quyosh o'lkasiga ketyapmiz!

5) KEYINROQ ...
   Tony: Yarim soatlarda yetib
   boramiz.
   Sandra: Voy! Manzaraga qara! Pastda
   ko'z yetguncha muz va qordan
   boshqa hech narsa yo'q!

6) Tony: Nima ... ? VOY, YO'Q!
   Sandra: Nima bo'ldi?

7) Tony: Dvigatel to'xtadi! Muz
   ustiga qo'nishga harakat qilaman.
   Mahkam ushlanglar!

8) Tony: MAYDAY! MAYDAY!


⚠ 'ON TOP OF THE WORLD':

  = dunyoning cho'qqisida (Shimoliy
  qutb); ko'chma = juda baxtli.


⚠ 'THE ARCTIC CIRCLE':

  = Shimoliy qutb doirasi.


⚠ 'A GLACIER':

  = muzlik. /ˈɡlæsiə/.


⚠ 'THE NORTH POLE':

  = Shimoliy qutb.


⚠ 'AN ASSIGNMENT':

  = topshiriq (ish).


⚠ 'ICE CAP':

  = muz qatlami (qoplami).


⚠ 'TO MELT':

  = erimoq.


⚠ 'A DISASTER':

  = falokat.


⚠ 'A RESEARCH STATION':

  = tadqiqot stansiyasi.


⚠ 'A DOGSLED':

  = it chanasi.


⚠ 'TO DISAPPOINT':

  = umidini puchga chiqarmoq.


⚠ "WE'D BETTER":

  = ...ganimiz ma'qul (maslahat).
  ⚠ 'had better' + fe'l (to siz).


⚠ 'THE SUN DOESN'T SET':

  = quyosh botmaydi.
  ⚠ 'sunset' = quyosh botishi.


⚠ 'THE MIDNIGHT SUN':

  = yarim tungi quyosh (qutbda yozda
  quyosh botmaydi).


⚠ 'AS FAR AS THE EYE CAN SEE':

  = ko'z yetguncha.


⚠ 'NOTHING BUT':

  = ...dan boshqa hech narsa.


⚠ 'AN ENGINE':

  = dvigatel.


⚠ 'TO LAND':

  = qo'nmoq.


⚠ 'HOLD ON TIGHT!':

  = Mahkam ushlang!


⚠ 'MAYDAY!':

  = xalqaro yordam chaqirig'i (radio
  orqali, falokatda).

tasks.en: Sandra and David are going to the Arctic Circle to write an article about Greenland's glaciers. Read the story.
tasks.uz: Sandra va David Grenlandiya muzliklari haqida maqola yozish uchun Shimoliy qutb doirasiga bormoqda. Hikoyani o'qing.

tasks.en: David: We're on our way to the top of the world! We're almost at the North Pole! Sandra: Yes! Isn't it exciting? I couldn't believe it when Mike told us about the assignment. He said that the Greenland ice cap is melting quickly and scientists are worried that it might cause an environmental disaster.
tasks.uz: David: Biz dunyoning cho'qqisiga ketyapmiz! Deyarli Shimoliy qutbdamiz! Sandra: Ha! Hayajonli emasmi? Mike bizga topshiriq haqida aytganida ishonmadim. U Grenlandiya muz qatlami tez erimoqda va olimlar bu ekologik falokatga sabab bo'lishi mumkin deb tashvishda, dedi.
tasks.note: ⚠ 1-kadr. 'He said that ... is melting' - umumiy haqiqat, zamon o'zgarmagan.

tasks.en: Tony: Welcome to Greenland. I'm Tony Francis, from the research station. It's more than 600 kilometres north of here, above the Arctic Circle. Sandra: How will we get there? I know it's too far, but I'd love to travel on a dogsled!
tasks.uz: Tony: Grenlandiyaga xush kelibsiz. Men Tony Francis, tadqiqot stansiyasidanman. U bu yerdan 600 km dan ko'proq shimolda, Shimoliy qutb doirasi ustida. Sandra: U yerga qanday boramiz? Juda uzoqligini bilaman, lekin it chanasida sayohat qilishni juda xohlardim!

tasks.en: Tony: Sorry to disappoint you, Sandra - we're travelling by plane. There it is! We'd better leave because it's getting late. Sandra: Will we reach the research station before it gets dark?
tasks.uz: Tony: Umidingni puchga chiqarganim uchun kechir, Sandra - samolyotda boramiz. Ana u! Ketganimiz ma'qul, chunki kech bo'lyapti. Sandra: Qorong'i tushishidan oldin tadqiqot stansiyasiga yetib boramizmi?

tasks.en: Tony: Don't worry, David - above the Arctic Circle the sun doesn't set in summer. We're going to the land of the midnight sun!
tasks.uz: Tony: Tashvishlanma, David - Shimoliy qutb doirasi ustida yozda quyosh botmaydi. Biz yarim tungi quyosh o'lkasiga ketyapmiz!

tasks.en: LATER ... Tony: We'll be there in about half an hour. Sandra: Wow! Look at the view! There's nothing but ice and snow down there, as far as the eye can see!
tasks.uz: KEYINROQ ... Tony: Yarim soatlarda yetib boramiz. Sandra: Voy! Manzaraga qara! Pastda ko'z yetguncha muz va qordan boshqa hech narsa yo'q!

tasks.en: Tony: What ... ? OH, NO! Sandra: What's wrong?
tasks.uz: Tony: Nima ... ? VOY, YO'Q! Sandra: Nima bo'ldi?

tasks.en: Tony: The engine's stopped! I'm going to try to land on the ice. Hold on tight!
tasks.uz: Tony: Dvigatel to'xtadi! Muz ustiga qo'nishga harakat qilaman. Mahkam ushlanglar!

exercises.instructionEn: Read the paragraph and fill in a, an or the where necessary. Then, say where we use a, an or the.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatboshini o'qing va kerak joyga a, an yoki the ni qo'ying. Keyin a, an yoki the ni qayerda ishlatishimizni ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 - (ism - artikl yo'q)
  2 the (Arctic Circle - yagona
    geografik nom)
  3 the (Greenland ice cap - aniq)
  4 an (environmental - unli, birinchi
    marta)
  5 a (dogsled - birinchi marta,
    undosh)
  6 - ('by plane' - transport,
    artiklsiz)
  7 the (research station - aniq,
    ma'lum)
  8 the (sun - yagona)
  9 - (summer - fasl, artiklsiz)
  10 the (engine - samolyotning
    aniq dvigateli)
  11 - (Tony - ism)
  12 the (ice - aniq, pastdagi muz)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  A / AN                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Birinchi marta tilga olingan,
  noaniq, birlik sanaladigan ot.
  'a dogsled', 'an environmental
  disaster' (unli → an).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  THE                             ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Aniq, ma'lum, yagona:
  the sun, the Arctic Circle, the
  research station, the engine.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ARTIKL YO'Q                     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Ismlar (David, Tony), 'by +
  transport' (by plane), fasllar
  (in summer).


⚠ 'INSTEAD':

  = o'rniga.
